about: subagent-inflight: the native hook writes a kind on each new started record; the Node oracle never wrote one.
ruling: Architect rev 4 Q1 and rev 5 G6, accepted by the Orchestrator (view-model-rev4 report 20261016-014402-6mxt)
node: hooks/subagent-inflight.mjs appends {type, session_id, agent_id, status, ts} for a started record, so a subagent, a background Bash and a Monitor cannot be told apart
native: Ah.Hooks SubagentInflight appends the same row with kind after ts: subagent for SubagentStart, background for a background Bash run or a Monitor; a stopped record copies the kind of the latest started record of that id, and a record seeded without a kind gets none
reason: the view's subagents field must list subagents only; records written before this change stay without a kind and are excluded from it

nativeOnly.proves: SubagentStart writes kind subagent after ts
a background Bash and a Monitor write kind background
a stop copies the kind of its start
a stop of a record seeded without a kind writes none
the started and stopped records carry kind subagent, run through bin/ah-hook
